map.TDS = (A×1.3) + (B×0.1) + (C×0.5) + (D×0: TDS = (A×1.3) + (B×0.1) + (C×0.5) + (D×0.5). A is the asymmetry score (0/1/2), B is the number of border-interrupted quadrants (0-8), C is the number of colors (1-6), D is the number of dermoscopic structures (1-5).
map.ABCD法则适用于评估色素性皮损的黑色素瘤风险，但不适用于：1. 面部雀斑样痣（: The ABCD rule applies to assessing melanoma risk of pigmented lesions but not to: 1. facial lentiginous nevus (HLA type); 2. acral melanoma (use the 3-step rule); 3. nodular melanoma (often false-negative); 4. amelanotic melanoma. Blue-white veil, atypical vascular pattern, and regression structures are independent high-risk signs of melanoma, warranting vigilance regardless of TDS.
